policy.owner_scope: Tenant and recipient are derived from authenticated request context and revalidated by NotificationInboxStorefrontPort
policy.principal_boundary: Missing authentication and OAuth service principals receive the same stable user-required envelope
policy.tenant_boundary: Authentication and tenant context must match before module or owner access
policy.module_boundary: The Notifications module must be enabled before grouped owner reads execute
policy.runtime_boundary: Manifest runtime data reuses the host database, materialized source registry, existing recipient policy runtime, and existing storefront port
policy.request_boundary: GraphQL grouped read arguments contain no tenant recipient or user identity
policy.port_boundary: Grouped GraphQL reads carry canonical user actor, claims, locale, storefront channel, correlation id, and five-second deadline
policy.paging_boundary: GraphQL Int limits reject negative and overflow values before owner clamping; cursors remain opaque bounded owner cursors
policy.authorization_boundary: Latest items and group items keep current recipient-policy and source target authorization checks
policy.wire_boundary: UUIDs and timestamps are strings, state and priority are enums, and bounded template data is key/value fields rather than arbitrary JSON
policy.transport_boundary: SSR and hydrate select native reads while CSR and headless select GraphQL with no fallback
policy.compatibility_boundary: Existing no-context UI read functions delegate to selected reads and native raw reads remain explicitly named
policy.error_boundary: Unsafe port and owner failures collapse to a generic stable unavailable GraphQL envelope
policy.write_boundary: Fresh open authorization and group-state commands remain native-only

not_delivered: auth-reactive automatic grouped inbox bootstrap refresh without an explicit resource refresh
